capabilities: Create tasks with natural language date and context parsing
Manage tasks in task list, Kanban, calendar and agenda views built on Bases
Track time per task with a Pomodoro timer and session history
Sync calendars with Google, Microsoft or any ICS feed
Define recurring tasks with per-instance completion and dependencies
extras: Full documentation lives on an external site; a beta web and iPhone version exists outside Obsidian; an optional HTTP API, CLI, browser extension and webhooks connect external tools.
intentEvidence: TaskNotes registers as a Bases data source and provides custom view types
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to manage tasks as individual queryable notes, and task plugins usually rely on a plugin-specific database that locks your data in.

relations.evidence: Calendar sync with Google and Microsoft (OAuth) or any ICS feed
Calendar sync with Google and Microsoft (OAuth) or any ICS feed

requires.name: Google or Microsoft calendar / ICS feed

summary: Task management plugin that stores each task as a Markdown note with YAML frontmatter and renders task list, Kanban, calendar and agenda views on Obsidian Bases.
